"''The Rivoche Ranges. You've done your homework.|Leia Organa and Wilhuff Tarkin|}} The '''Rivoche Ranges''' were a [[mountain]] range on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Eriadu]]. At some point, the planet's [[Homeworld|native]] [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] learned about the range. In [[3 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'' to [[3 BBY]]. the [[Alderaanian]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] conducted research on Eriadu's terrain in preparation for her upcoming [[pathfinding]] class trip to the planet. While attending an [[Apprentice Legislature]] reception on the [[Core Worlds]] planet [[Coruscant]], Organa met Tarkin and asked him about the mountain ranges on his homeworld, hoping to flatter the Eriadu native by letting him expound on a topic with which he was familiar. Tarkin told the princess about the Rivoche Ranges, remarking that she had done her research. ==Behind the scenes== The Rivoche Ranges were mentioned in ''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'', a [[2017]] young-adult novel written by [[Claudia Gray]]. The Rivoche Ranges partially share their name with [[Rivoche Tarkin]], a character introduced to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in "[[Eyewitness to Apocalypse]]," a vignette written by [[Michael Allen Horne]] for the [[West End Games]]' [[1993]] ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''.{{WEGCite|story=Eyewitness to Apocalypse|book=Dark Empire Sourcebook}} ==Appearances== *''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'' {{Ab|Leia, Princess of Alderaan (audiobook)}} {{1stm}} *''[[Leia Organa: Ordeal of the Princess]]'' {{Mo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Rivochegebirge#kanon |fr=Chaînes Rivoche }} [[Category:Eriadu locations]] [[Category:Mountain ranges]]
